- 26 days' holiday, rising to 28 days after 2 years' service and 31 days after 5 years' service (pro rated for part time opportunities)

- Organising and allocating Safe and Well Visits received from partner agencies to Partnership Officers, Partnership Leads and operational crews across Surrey.
- Acting as a first point of contact for members of the public and partner agencies, responding to telephone and written enquiries in a professional and timely manner.
- Supporting the use of internal systems used to record and manage Safe and Well Visits.

Prevention is at the heart of Surrey Fire and Rescue Service, and this role offers the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on community safety. Through strong organisation, communication and partnership working, you will help ensure vulnerable residents receive the right advice and support, enabling our teams to deliver effective interventions that help people stay safe in their homes.

Over the next 12 to 18 months, you will support the continued delivery and development of Safe and Well Visits across Surrey. Working within the Partnership Team, you will help manage referrals efficiently, ensure accurate and timely information is shared with operational teams and partner agencies, and contribute to improving administrative processes, reporting and the effective use of internal systems to support prevention activity across the Service.

- Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage a varied workload effectively.

- Confidence communicating with members of the public, colleagues and partner organisations.

- Please describe your experience of using Microsoft Office applications or other digital systems to manage information, records or reporting.
- Tell us about a time when you worked with colleagues or partner organisations to achieve a positive outcome.

The job advert closes at 23:59 on 18th of October 2026 with interviews planned to follow.

Surrey County Council is undergoing Local Government Reorganisation and will move to new authorities in April 2027.
